HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Human developmen ts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human developmen ts in Africa.
   B. Treat Human developmen ts in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Human developmen ts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Human developmen ts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
